canonical_example.text: Hagamos una apuesta a ver cuál de los caballos llega primero.
canonical_example.translation: Let's make a bet to see which horse is first.

canonical_example.text: Hizo un apuesta de $500 en el casino y perdió.
canonical_example.translation: He made a bet of $500 at the casino and lost.

canonical_example.text: En mi país, las apuestas y la venta de alcohol estuvieron prohibidas hasta 1944.
canonical_example.translation: In my country, gambling and alcohol consumption were banned until 1944.

canonical_example.text: Los Smith son gente encantadora.
canonical_example.translation: The Smiths are charming people.

canonical_example.text: Diana es una niña encantadora y bien educada.
canonical_example.translation: Diana is a delightful and well-educated girl.

canonical_example.text: Hacen una pareja encantadora.
canonical_example.translation: They make a lovely couple.

canonical_example.text: Vimos a un encantador de serpientes en Marruecos.
canonical_example.translation: We saw a snake charmer in Morocco.

canonical_example.text: Visitamos un pueblo encantador en las montañas.
canonical_example.translation: We visited a charming town in the mountains.

canonical_example.text: Este pueblito tiene unos lugares encantadores con vistas espectaculares.
canonical_example.translation: This small town has some enchanting places with spectacular views.

canonical_example.text: Yo no creo en la magia de los encantadores.
canonical_example.translation: I do not believe in the magic of enchanters.

canonical_example.text: Merlín era el encantador que educó a Arturo.
canonical_example.translation: Merlin was the wizard who educated Arthur.

canonical_example.text: En su saco, tenía todo lo que necesitaba para sobrevivir en la tierra salvaje.
canonical_example.translation: In his sack, he had everything he needed to survive in the wilderness.

canonical_example.text: Llevo sacos reutilizables al supermercado para ser menos derrochador.
canonical_example.translation: I bring reusable bags to the grocery store to be less wasteful.

canonical_example.text: Se veía muy bien esa noche con su saco formal.
canonical_example.translation: He looked very good that night in his formal jacket.

canonical_example.text: Hace un poco de frío. Me voy a poner un saco.
canonical_example.translation: It's a bit cold. I'm going to put on a cardigan.

canonical_example.text: Tuvimos que subir por las escaleras.
canonical_example.translation: We had to go up the stairs.

canonical_example.text: La escalera da al mar.
canonical_example.translation: The stairway leads to the ocean.

canonical_example.text: Las escaleras están oscuras de noche.
canonical_example.translation: The staircase is dark at night.

canonical_example.text: Los bomberos siempre llevan una escalera en su camión.
canonical_example.translation: The firefighters always carry a ladder on their truck.

canonical_example.text: Su full le ganó a mi escalera.
canonical_example.translation: Her full house beat my straight.

canonical_example.text: Lo que el país necesita es un instituto nacional de estadística que sea independiente.
canonical_example.translation: What our country needs is a national statistics institute that is independent.

canonical_example.text: En 1815 fundó un instituto dedicado a la promoción de las artes.
canonical_example.translation: He founded an institute committed to promoting the arts in 1815.

canonical_example.text: ¡Claro que conozco a Carlos! ¡Fuimos juntos al instituto!
canonical_example.translation: Of course I know Carlos! We went to high school together!

canonical_example.text: Debe ser una persona sin conciencia para dejar al perro sin agua tanto tiempo.
canonical_example.translation: He must be a person without a conscience to leave his dog without water for so long.

canonical_example.text: Natalia se fue a un retiro espiritual a elevar su nivel de conciencia.
canonical_example.translation: Natalia went on a spiritual retreat to raise her level of awareness.

canonical_example.text: Su conciencia de lo que pasa más allá de su pueblo crece cada día.
canonical_example.translation: Her knowledge of events beyond her town is growing every day.

canonical_example.text: El documental me concienció sobre mi adicción a la comida.
canonical_example.translation: The documentary made me aware of my food addiction.

canonical_example.text: La campaña de salud logró concienciar a los fumadores de los peligros.
canonical_example.translation: The health campaign succeeded in raising smokers' awareness of the dangers.

canonical_example.text: No me conciencié de mi depresión hasta que hablé con un psicólogo.
canonical_example.translation: I didn't become aware of my depression until I spoke wtih a psychologist.

canonical_example.text: La policía vino y despertó a todo el edificio.
canonical_example.translation: The police came and woke up the whole building.

canonical_example.text: Por donde quiera que vaya despierta simpatías.
canonical_example.translation: Wherever he goes he arouses sympathy.

canonical_example.text: Los olores despertaron viejos recuerdos de la infancia.
canonical_example.translation: The smells awakened old childhood memories.

canonical_example.text: Con el despertar de la naturaleza en primavera, florecen muchas flores hermosas.
canonical_example.translation: With the awakening of nature in spring, many beautiful flowers bloom.

canonical_example.text: Me desperté cuando sonó el despertador.
canonical_example.translation: I woke up when the alarm clock went off.

canonical_example.text: No me hagas una promesa así si no la puedes cumplir.
canonical_example.translation: Don't make me a promise like that if you can't keep it.

canonical_example.text: Ella es una joven promesa del arte de escultura.
canonical_example.translation: She brings such young talent to the art of sculpture.

canonical_example.text: Usa alcohol puro para borrar el marcador permanente.
canonical_example.translation: Use pure alcohol to remove permanent marker.

canonical_example.text: Encontré la billetera que perdiste de pura casualidad.
canonical_example.translation: I've found the wallet you lost by pure chance.

canonical_example.text: Gritó a todos en el cuarto de pura rabia.
canonical_example.translation: She screamed at everyone in the room out of sheer rage.

canonical_example.text: Dice que solo se va a casar con una mujer que sea pura.
canonical_example.translation: He says he will only get married to a woman who is pure.

canonical_example.text: Este anillo de oro puro cuesta un medio millón de dólares.
canonical_example.translation: This solid gold ring costs half a million dollars.

canonical_example.text: Necesito irme de la ciudad para respirar aire puro.
canonical_example.translation: I need to leave the city to breathe clean air.

canonical_example.text: El sacerdote cree que solamente un hombre y una mujer puros pueden experimentar el amor verdadero.
canonical_example.translation: The priest believes only chaste men and women can experience true love.

canonical_example.text: Mi amigo de Ghana cree que en los Estados Unidos hay puros ricos.
canonical_example.translation: My friend from Ghana believes that there are only rich people in the United States.

canonical_example.text: ¿Dijo que yo le robé dinero? Son puras mentiras.
canonical_example.translation: He said I stole his money? That's just lies.

canonical_example.text: Mi padre siempre fuma puros habanos cuando juega al póquer.
canonical_example.translation: My father always smokes Cuban cigars when he is playing poker.

canonical_example.text: Me metieron un puro por fumar en el baño.
canonical_example.translation: They threw the book at me for smoking in the bathroom.

canonical_example.translation: I've got into a muddle with the keys and now I don't know which is which.

canonical_example.translation: He made a big fuss about something totally unimportant.

canonical_example.translation: The washerwomen walked towards the river, with their bundles of clothes on their heads.

canonical_example.text: He is a liar and he will never tell the truth.

canonical_example.text: Your lover is a liar.

canonical_example.translation: The congregation prayed to the chosen one.

canonical_example.translation: Samantha was the person chosen to represent her class in the ceremony.

canonical_example.text: Hay creyentes que piensan que ellos son los elegidos y que los demás arderán en el infierno.
canonical_example.translation: There are believers who think that they are the elect and that everyone else will burn in hell.

canonical_example.text: Ahora que Pablo ha empezado a ir a misa de nuevo, se comporta como si fuera uno de los elegidos.
canonical_example.translation: Just because Pablo has started going to church again, he's acting as he's one of the chosen few.
